description: Retrieves a file from a GitLab repository's raw file endpoint as text, without Base64 encoding. The response includes the content type when available.

file_path.description: The full path to the file in the repository (e.g., 'app/models/key.rb').
file_path.title: File Path

lfs.description: When true, returns Git LFS file contents instead of the pointer file. Ignored for non-LFS tracked files.
lfs.title: Lfs

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
project_id.title: Project Id

ref.description: The name of branch, tag, or commit to retrieve the file from. Defaults to HEAD (the project's default branch).
ref.title: Ref

name: get_raw_file

content.description: The raw file contents as a string. For binary files, this will contain the raw bytes as a string.
content.title: Content

content_type.description: The content type of the file from the response headers (e.g., 'text/plain', 'application/json').
content_type.title: Content Type
